# Tailwind CSS 4 patterns — cn() utility, theme variables, no var() in className

Curated by Skill Harbor — @gentleman-programming's tailwind-4: an opinionated Tailwind CSS 4 styling skill. Core rules: a styling decision tree (Tailwind class exists → className; dynamic value → style prop; conditional → cn(); library can't use class → style prop with var() constants), never var() or hex colors in className (always semantic Tailwind classes), the cn() utility (clsx + tailwind-merge) with explicit when-to-use/when-not-to rules, style constants for libraries that don't accept className (Recharts), style props for truly dynamic values, plus flexbox/grid/spacing/typography/borders/states/responsive/dark-mode patterns and the arbitrary-value escape hatch.
